messages:
Evan Park: Heads-up — SignalMesh sent the renewal workbook. they want a 15% list increase and changed metering: split lines for "generation" vs "contextual embeddings" which affects our invoices.
Lena Ortiz: link? can you attach their calc? we need the last 12 months mapped to their new categories before we respond.
Evan Park: uploaded CSV: <https://files.internal/signalmesh/renewal_workbook_q1-4.csv> their sample invoice shows embeddings billed at a new per-embed unit which bumps our last-quarter baseline.
Mike Donovan: finance saw ~7% unexplained variance vs our internal usage last quarter. need formal reconciliation language and audit rights in the contract.
CFO-Bot: FYI: any renewal impact over $200k or >10% YoY needs exec sign-off.
Lena Ortiz: negotiation checklist I'm proposing: 1) cap annual price increase at 5% 2) require invoice-level true-ups with monthly credits for misbilling 3) right to conduct a joint billing audit annually 4) machine-readable billing exports and a billing API.
LegalBot: flagged clauses: metering change notice unclear; indemnity language broad; also missing SLA credit mechanics. propose: 1) 60-day advance notice for metering changes, 2) no retroactive reclassification of prior usage, 3) SLA credit: 5% invoice credit for month if P95 latency > SLO or availability < 99.9%.
Mike Donovan: also ask for a reconciliation runway: vendor must re-run invoices within 45 days of disputed invoice and apply credits automatically if error found.
Evan Park: Draft counter to send: ``Highlights:
- Term: 12 months; renewal conditional on mutual usage review
- Price increase cap: 5% annually
- Metering: 60-day notice for changes; no retroactive reclassification
- Billing: monthly machine-readable export + billing API; invoice-level credits applied next invoice upon dispute resolution
- Audit: joint annual billing audit with 30-day remediation window
- Remedies: 10% credit if vendor error causes >$5k overcharge in a month; SLA credits as LegalBot suggested
- Notice: 90-day notice before any metering or unit definition changes
``
Lena Ortiz: looks good. add explicit prohibition on treating embeddings as a new surcharge category retroactively (we've seen vendors reclassify mid-term).
Mike Donovan: add requirement for sample mapping run: vendor to run their new metering logic on a 6-month sample of our data and share line-by-line differences before we accept new terms.
Evan Park: added both. final ask: insist any pricing uplift is applied prospectively only. sending counter now.
ProcurementBot: SignalMesh renewal counter posted by Evan Park. Status: awaiting vendor response.
